svg.title: Algebraizing a finite étale cover over a complete base
svg.desc: Nilpotent lifting produces compatible locally free cover algebras. Coherent existence lifts the module and all algebra laws. Krull intersection and properness prove local freeness and vanishing of differentials, yielding a finite étale cover. The scheme need not be flat over the complete base.

g.text: Algebraize the cover and all its laws
A Noetherian and I-adically complete; X proper/A
Xₙ = X ×A Spec(A/Iⁿ); X/A may be nonflat.
Y₁ → X₁ finite étale
Lift through every nilpotent thickening.
unique marked lifts
Bₙ = (Yₙ → Xₙ)* OYₙ
Finite locally free over OXₙ; compatible.
Base-flatness over A is not a hypothesis.
coherent existence
A coherent module B on X
Its quotient modulo Iⁿ is the specified Bₙ.
full faithfulness on maps
μ: B ⊗ B → B and η: OX → B
Associativity, commutativity, unit laws
hold because their completions agree.
local module calculation
At X₁, B is free and ΩB/OX = 0.
Every formal quotient gives the same rank.
Krull intersection kills the kernel;
Nakayama kills the differential module there.
properness kills bad loci
Y = SpecX B → X is finite étale.
Its restriction is the given cover Y₁.
FÉt(X) → FÉt(X₁) is an equivalence.
Finite constant-group torsors lift too.
Noncomplete henselian effectivity requires another argument.
